newsitem.title: UK: Coffee group technical meeting ends.
newsitem.headline: Coffee group technical meeting ends.

text.p: Monday's technical meeting of the Association of Coffee Producing Countries (ACPC) ended with an agreement on a proposal to submit to a full session on Wednesday, ACPC chairman Rubens Barbosa of Brazil said.
He declined to specify what proposal was.
"There is an agreement on a proposal to be submitted to the council at their meeting on Wednesday," Barbosa said. But he could not disclose details out of fairness to "others who are not here".
"The meeting was very good and very positive," he said.
There was just one proposal to be submitted, he added.
Six of the 14 ACPC members form the technical group, whilst Honduras and Costa Rica sat in as observers.
The six are Brazil, Columbia, Uganda, Ivory Coast, El Salvador and Indonesia.
